2025-09-08.riddle: I can capture moments without a brush or pen. I freeze time with a single click. What am I?

2025-09-09.riddle: I march without feet, I roar without a throat, and I topple mountains grain by grain. What am I?
2025-09-09.hint: I carve valleys with patience, not strength.

2025-09-10.riddle: I vanish when you look straight at me, yet I dance at the edge of your sight. I appear on hot roads and desert sands. What am I?
2025-09-10.hint: I’m an illusion born of heat.

2025-09-11.riddle: I lock away treasure without key or code. Crack me, and you’ll find yellow or white inside. What am I?
2025-09-11.hint: I break easily, but I protect life.

2025-09-12.riddle: I fall from the sky, yet I never bruise. I blanket the earth in silence and white. What am I?
2025-09-12.hint: I melt away when warmth arrives.

2025-09-13.riddle: I climb but never tire, my light guides sailors and travelers alike. I vanish each dawn. What am I?
2025-09-13.hint: I fill the night sky with company.

2025-09-14.riddle: I can hold castles, mountains, and seas, yet I fit in your palm. Shake me and storms begin. What am I?
2025-09-14.hint: A winter world trapped in glass.

2025-09-15.riddle: I rise only when the sun departs, glowing softly but never burning. I borrow light and change my face each night. What am I?
